title: Create a PCB project with a blank schematic
summary: Creates a new PCB project by sending the WorkspaceManager:OpenObject process, then creates a blank schematic with DM_CreateNewDocument, adds it to the project and opens it, checking that the new project is the focused one.
phrasings: create a new PrjPcb from code
add a new SchDoc to a project
make a new project and open a blank sheet
run a workspace process when no API exists
